mapper.select:
SELECT p.id, p.num, p.organization_id AS organizationId, p.name, p.description, p.create_time AS createTime, p.update_time AS updateTime, p.update_user AS updateUser, p.create_user AS createUser, p.delete_time AS deleteTime, p.deleted, p.delete_user AS deleteUser, p.enable, p.module_setting AS moduleSetting, p.all_resource_pool AS allResourcePool, p.is_default AS isDefault FROM project p
ORDER BY
CASE WHEN CAST(p.num AS CHAR) = #{keyword} THEN 0 WHEN LOWER(p.id) = LOWER(#{keyword}) THEN 1 WHEN LOWER(p.name) = LOWER(#{keyword}) THEN 2 WHEN LOWER(p.name) LIKE CONCAT(LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') THEN 3 WHEN LOWER(p.name) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{likeKeyword}, '%') THEN 4 WHEN CAST(p.num AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') THEN 5 WHEN LOWER(p.id) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{likeKeyword}, '%') THEN 6 ELSE 10 END ASC,
p.update_time DESC, p.id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
